Class Fleet

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Fleet
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFleet
public class Fleet extends Object implements IFleet
Represents a fleet of ships in the Battleship game.

A fleet manages a collection of ships on the board, enforcing rules regarding board boundaries, maximum fleet size, and proximity constraints between ships.

    • addShip

      public boolean addShip(IShip s)
      Adds a ship to the fleet if it satisfies all placement rules.

      The ship will only be added if the total fleet size does not exceed IFleet.FLEET_SIZE, the ship is within board boundaries, and it does not violate collision or proximity rules with existing ships.

      Specified by:
      addShip in interface IFleet
      Parameters:
      s - the ship to add
      Returns:
      true if the ship was successfully added; false otherwise
